## spe/evals/harness/grader.js (changed part)

```js
function normPriority(p) {
  return String(p ?? '').trim().toUpperCase();
}
const VALID_PRIORITIES = ['P1', 'P2', 'P3', 'P4'];

function gradePriority(trialValue, refValue) {
  const t = normPriority(trialValue);
  if (!VALID_PRIORITIES.includes(t)) return false;
  return t === normPriority(refValue);
}
```
